title: 第3132章 时间空间因果的较量第3131章 魂源的争夺战
slug: 全球守护灵开局获得东皇帝俊
content_zh:
圣耀世双手高举，圣光神国虚影再次浮现。
但这次，神国中央，一本由纯粹圣光凝聚的“圣典”缓缓翻开，浩荡的圣言响起。
“圣族曰，光，利万物，养化物，光，亦寂灭万物。
圣族曰，异族当净化，圣裁降临！”无穷圣光汇聚，化作一柄横亘天地的“圣裁之剑”，带着净化一切的终极意志，锁定叶馨叶欣！
渡心则盘坐莲台，宝相庄严，身后浮现一尊巨大的佛祖虚影，佛祖拈花微笑，口中吐出金色梵文：“唵、嘛、呢、叭、咪、吽……”
六字大明咒化作实质的金色符文洪流，带着渡化众生、镇压诸邪的无上佛力，席卷向神魔太极图！
叶馨叶欣感受到前所未有的压力，太极图旋转速度暴增，两人气息完全相连，神魔之力催动到极致。
叶馨手中太极道剑绽放纯净神光，叶欣手中道剑吞吐深邃魔气，双剑合璧，迎向圣裁之剑与六字大明咒！
另一边，叶君与剑破虚的剑道对决，已到了比拼剑心与意志的极限。
两人身上都添了数道深可见骨的剑伤，但眼神却越发璀璨明亮。
他们的剑域早已融合、碰撞、破碎了无数次，此刻方圆千丈内，只剩下最纯粹的剑意纵横，其他大道本源都被排斥在外。
“你的剑，够利，但还不够‘绝’。”叶君忽然开口，青锋剑上鸿蒙之气内敛到极致，仿佛返璞归真。
“你的剑，变化有余，但还不够‘纯’。”剑破虚古剑“破虚”震颤，剑尖一点寒芒凝聚，仿佛能刺破万古虚空。
两人同时动了！
没有惊天动地的声势，只有两道仿佛跨越了时空的剑光，无声无息地对撞在一起。
叮——！
一声轻响，仿佛珠落玉盘。时间仿佛在这一刻静止。
紧接着，以两人剑尖交汇处为中心，一圈纯粹由破碎剑意构成的涟漪扩散开来，所过之处，连空间都出现了细密的黑色裂痕！
噗！噗！
两人同时喷出一口鲜血，各自倒飞出去。叶君胸前多了一道贯穿伤，剑气肆虐。

剑破虚持剑的右臂齐肩而断，鲜血喷涌。
但两人的眼睛却亮得吓人，这一剑，他们都触摸到了更高的剑道门槛！
叶战与战不败的战斗依旧是最野蛮、最直接的肉身与战意碰撞。
两人都已伤痕累累，黄金战甲破碎，露出精悍的身躯，但战意却燃烧到前所未有的高度。
他们的战斗范围不断扩大，逼得附近交战的几个中等族群天骄不得不连连后退。
“痛快！哈哈哈！叶战，你是我遇到过最强的对手！”
战不败狂笑，断了一臂，却以战意凝聚出新的黄金手臂，再次扑上。
“你也不差！但胜利者，只会是我！”叶战同样战意冲霄，身上伤口在黄金战意的燃烧下快速愈合，一拳比一拳重，一脚比一脚狠。
叶天与敖苍古的混沌之战，已从大道本源的比拼，上升到了对混沌本质理解的交锋。
两人所在的区域彻底化为一片混沌海，地风水火不断重演又破灭，龙吟与道音交织。
敖苍古显化出九爪祖龙真身，在混沌中翻腾，每一爪都蕴含着开天辟地的伟力。
叶天则身与混沌合，重瞳演化混沌生灭，举手投足间引动混沌大势，以柔克刚，以静制动。
content_en:
Sheng Yaoshi raised his hands high, and the shadow of the Kingdom of Holy Light appeared again.
But this time, in the center of the Kingdom of God, a "holy book" condensed by pure holy light was slowly opened, and the mighty holy words sounded.
“The saints say that light benefits all things and nourishes them, and light also destroys all things.
The saints say that foreigners should be purified and the Holy Judgment is coming! "The infinite holy light gathered and turned into a "Sword of Holy Judgment" spanning the world, locking Ye Xin Ye Xin with the ultimate will to purify everything!
Du Xin is sitting cross-legged on a lotus platform with a solemn appearance. Behind him appears a huge phantom of the Buddha. The Buddha holds flowers and smiles, and spits out golden Sanskrit words: "Om, ma, ni, ba, mi, hum..."
The six-character Great Ming Mantra turned into a substantial torrent of golden runes, carrying the supreme Buddha power to transform all living beings and suppress all evils, sweeping towards the Tai Chi Diagram of Gods and Demons!
Ye Xin felt unprecedented pressure. The rotation speed of the Tai Chi diagram increased dramatically. The breaths of the two were completely connected, and the power of gods and demons was pushed to the extreme.
The Tai Chi Taoist sword in Ye Xin's hand bloomed with pure divine light, and the Taoist sword in Ye Xin's hand breathed deep demonic energy. The two swords were combined to face the Holy Judgment Sword and the Six-Word Ming Dynasty Mantra!
On the other side, the kendo duel between Ye Jun and Jian Poxu has reached the limit of the sword's heart and will.
Both of them had several sword wounds with bone-deep wounds on their bodies, but their eyes became brighter and brighter.
Their sword realms have already merged, collided, and broken countless times. At this moment, within a thousand feet radius, only the purest sword intent is left, and other avenues of origin are excluded.
"Your sword is sharp enough, but not 'perfect' enough." Ye Jun suddenly spoke, the Qingfeng sword's Hongmeng Qi restrained to the extreme, as if returning to nature.
"Your sword has enough changes, but it's not 'pure' enough." The ancient sword "Poxu" trembled, and a cold light condensed on the tip of the sword, as if it could pierce the eternal void.
They both moved at the same time!
There was no earth-shattering momentum, only two sword lights that seemed to span time and space, colliding together silently.
bite--!
There was a soft sound, like a pearl falling on a jade plate. Time seems to stand still at this moment.
Immediately afterwards, centered on the intersection of the two sword tips, a circle of ripples composed purely of broken sword intent spread, and wherever it passed, fine black cracks appeared in the space!
puff! puff!
The two of them spurted out a mouthful of blood at the same time, and each flew backwards. Ye Jun had a penetrating wound on his chest, and the sword energy was raging.
Jian Poxu's right arm holding the sword was broken at shoulder level, and blood spurted out.
But their eyes were frighteningly bright. With this sword strike, they both touched a higher threshold of swordsmanship!
The battle between Ye Zhan and Zhan Bubai is still the most brutal and direct collision between physical body and fighting spirit.
Both of them were scarred, and their golden armors were broken, revealing their strong bodies, but their fighting spirit was burning to an unprecedented height.
The scope of their battle continued to expand, forcing the geniuses of several middle-level ethnic groups fighting nearby to retreat continuously.
"So happy! Hahaha! Ye Zhan, you are the strongest opponent I have ever encountered!"
Zhan Bubai laughed wildly and broke his arm, but he used his fighting spirit to gather a new golden arm and pounced again.
"You're not bad either! But the winner will only be me!" Ye Zhan was also filled with fighting spirit, and the wounds on his body healed quickly under the burning of golden fighting spirit. Each punch was heavier than the last, and each kick was harder than the last.
The battle of chaos between Ye Tian and Ao Canggu has risen from a competition over the origin of the avenue to a confrontation over the understanding of the essence of chaos.
The area where the two of them were located was completely transformed into a sea of ​​chaos. Earth, wind, water, and fire kept repeating themselves and then shattering, and dragon chants and Taoist sounds intertwined.
Ao Canggu manifested the true form of the nine-clawed ancestral dragon, writhing in the chaos, and each claw contained the power of opening up the world.
Ye Tianze's body merges with chaos, his double pupils evolve into the birth and death of chaos, and he activates the general trend of chaos with every movement of his hands and feet, overcoming rigidity with softness and stopping with stillness.
